overall_quality.evidence: Containerization is a method of packaging software into standardized units called containers. Containers are lightweight, portable, and self-sufficient, which makes them ideal for deploying and scaling applications. They are based on an operating system-level virtualization technology, which allows multiple isolated user spaces to exist on a single host.
